name: opencode-system-prompt-tools
description: system-prompt-tools.ts opencode plugin (dumps the fully-assembled system prompt actually sent to the model, on every request, to ~/.local/share/opencode/last-system-prompt.txt), packed and installed locally by extracting this tarball straight into opencode's own package cache under a bare name@version (no registry, no server - see CLAUDE.md). Written in TypeScript against @opencode-ai/plugin's Plugin type. After editing system-prompt-tools.ts, run `npm pack` in this directory to regenerate the committed opencode-system-prompt-tools-1.0.0.tgz - tests/unit/plugins-tarball.test.mjs fails the build if it drifts from source.
